page.layout: Running head at top, centred over the columns. Below it two columns of Scripture references: the left column runs full height, with chapter and verse references on the left and page numbers on the right. Beside it, at top right, a partly visible second column whose lines are cut off below the first two.; One table of two columns: chapter and verse references at the left edge, printed page and tome references at the right, with a rule to the left of the right column. Heading "II. AD CORINTHIOS." across the table. The left part of the page is blank.
page.notes: The right-hand column is cut off at the right edge after its first lines; only "v.13. 681.t.5.&" and the start of the next line are visible, so the line "682.t.8" is partly hidden and marked [?]. The reference numbers in the left column are copied as printed (e.g. "C.IX.4 5.6." shown with the printed points). No page number is visible at the head or foot of this part. The right-hand column of printed references is continuous from the top of the page to the foot of the table. Some references in the right column read "t." for "tom." (volume), as printed. The line "v.10." at the foot has no reference at its right, as printed.
